title: Google Gemini Live Voices List & Personal Intelligence Fix
description: How to change Gemini's voice (Ursa, Vega, Capella, Dipper, Pegasus, Orbit, Flare, Glow), set Personal Intelligence rules & fix Gemini Live sync gaps.
h1: Google Gemini Live voices and Personal Intelligence: voice list, setup, and sync fix.
dek: Pick a Gemini voice (including female, male, and British Capella), configure Instructions for Gemini, and fix the bug where Gemini Live skips saved rules.
lede: Google Gemini lets you pick your spoken voice across Gemini Live and text-chat Listen playback, while grouping custom rules and memory under Settings & help → Personal Intelligence. Below is the complete voice guide, interactive matcher, and the quick 1-prompt fix when Gemini Live ignores your saved instructions.
answer: To change Gemini's voice on Android or iOS, open the Gemini app → Profile → Settings → Gemini's voice (or tap the three-dot menu inside an active Gemini Live session) and pick from Ursa, Vega, Capella (British), Eclipse, Dipper, Pegasus, Orbit, Orion, Flare, or Glow. Save permanent tone rules under Settings & help → Personal Intelligence → Instructions for Gemini.

sections.h2: Gemini Live voice options (female, male, British & refreshed voices).
sections.html:
Google shifted Gemini’s voice picker from a horizontal carousel to a vertical list and has gradually replaced early names like Lyra and Nova with refreshed voices such as Flare and Glow depending on app version and region:

Tip: If a newly picked Gemini voice reverts on Android, switch temporarily to a different voice and back, or clear the Gemini app cache to force an account sync.

sections.h2: Fix: why Gemini Live ignores saved Personal Intelligence rules (and the 10-second workaround).
sections.html:
Many users add crisp tone rules under Settings & help → Personal Intelligence → Instructions for Gemini (formerly Saved info) and see them work in text chats—only for Gemini Live to revert to chatty, verbose replies.

Why it happens: Gemini Live uses low-latency streaming models that occasionally fail to hydrate background Personal Intelligence entries automatically on cold start.

The 10-second fix: Before tapping the Live icon, send one text message in that chat:

What instructions have I saved under Personal Intelligence? List them in two short lines and follow them when I switch to Live mode now.

Once Gemini echoes your rules back into the active conversation window, tap Gemini Live—the voice session inherits the active thread context immediately.

faq.q: How do I change Google Gemini's voice on Android or iOS?
faq.a: Open the Gemini app, tap your profile picture → Settings → Gemini's voice, preview the options (including female, male, and British Capella), and tap Select. You can also switch voices mid-session via the three-dot menu inside Gemini Live.

Google groups Saved info and chat Memory under Settings & help → Personal Intelligence, with separate toggles for Instructions for Gemini (manual rules) and Memory (facts learned from chats). Note that work, school, and supervised accounts may restrict these toggles.

faq.q: Which Gemini voice has a British accent?
faq.a: Capella offers a serene, higher-pitched British accent in Gemini's core voice lineup, alongside expanded regional accents rolling out in newer Gemini app updates.

faq.q: How do I make Gemini Live stop talking so much?
faq.a: Add a spoken-length rule ('Keep spoken answers to 2–4 sentences and lead with the takeaway') under Personal Intelligence → Instructions for Gemini, and seed the text thread before launching Live if it forgets.
